title: Claude Can Edit Your Videos Now
description:
What if Claude could edit your videos for you?

In this video, I show an open-source workflow that connects Claude to a video editor, helping automate parts of the editing process.

Here's what it can do:

• Analyze your raw footage
• Select the best takes
• Build a rough cut automatically
• Add B-roll suggestions
• Insert sound effects and overlays
• Organize your media library

The tool is open source, making it an interesting option for creators looking to speed up repetitive editing tasks.

If you're creating content every week, this AI workflow is worth exploring.

Check the pinned comment for the repo and setup guide.

#ai #videoediting #claude #opensource #aitools #contentcreator #automation #filmmaking #youtube #techlover
